theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_fc_extend_to_univ
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.support ⊆ K → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = X ∧ Y.support ⊆ K ∧ Y.mass ≤ X.mass ∧ Y.boundary.mass ≤ X.boundary.mass
